name: Stigmatize (Dark Thaumaturgy (Taking of the Spirit), Basic)

system.activation: Probes deeper into the victim's psyche, impairing her ability to relate to others without any obvious cause. Win a Static Mental Challenge against her Mental Traits; she must bid an extra Social Trait on all Social Challenges for the rest of the scene. Usable only once per scene on a given target, though multiple infernalists may stack it.
